title: A Landfall for the Monsoon
author: Noor Hartwell
blurb: Ansel Marchetti, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
